faq.question: Do I need a VR headset?
faq.answer: No. VRChat runs on desktop too, so you can take part with a keyboard and mouse.

faq.question: Do I need to know Star Wars lore?
faq.answer: No. You'll pick it up as you go, and plenty of members are happy to explain the 228th's own lore.

faq.question: What if I can't make an operation?
faq.answer: Let your leadership know. Real life always comes first here.

faq.question: Is the 228th only on VRChat?
faq.answer: VRChat is our main home today. We have run text roleplay and Arma 3 milsim before, and we stay open to new platforms and allied communities.

faq.question: Can I have custom armor?
faq.answer:
Yes, to an extent. Rank will still dictate whether you're able to have pauldrons and/or kamas, and custom armor has to be approved by Flanker before being made. Armor must not be too extravagant or over the top, so it meets the uniform and consistent look of the 228th. That means no colors other than our camo design, black, gray, and small amounts of red. No color changes to the camo or camo style can be made. What we have is standard, is not to be changed, and changes will be refused.
Very small accent colors other than those can be added but must be minimal. By minimal I mean it shouldn't be noticeable, just there, and the smallest of accents like tally marks or thin lines. But that is all.

faq.question: How do I get promoted?
faq.answer:
It depends on your rank, as promotions have different requirements. As a Clone Recruit (CR-C), your promotion to Clone Trooper (CT) is based on:
1. Attitude
2. Activity
3. Performance
4. Leadership
Ranks above CT are obtained by showing leadership traits and other field qualities that are in line with the 228th to the command staff. Every time you get promoted, a ceremony takes place at the end of the operation for people to witness, and an announcement will also be made letting everyone know of your good work.

faq.question: Are there awards?
faq.answer:
Yes. Awards are given to troopers who show:
- Acts of good conduct
- Bravery in battle
to name a few. There are also awards for surviving history-making moments in the unit.

faq.question: Can I be an ARC and a pilot?
faq.answer:
Not as your MOS. You can't be both an ARC and a pilot, but you can be an ARC trooper with pilot qualifications. An MOS (Military Occupational Specialty) is your primary job, while something like "Heavy" is just a qualification, not an MOS. You can't be an ARC and a Commando at the same time; those are two separate paths. However, an ARC can have additional qualifications, like pilot, engineer, or medic certifications.
For example, an ARC trooper with medic qualifications could serve as a medic within his ARC squad, but unlike a full-time field medic, he wouldn't be responsible for providing aid across the broader main forces. His role would stay focused on supporting his own team.
